_comment: Morena-nano 0.21B student: 12L x 1024d, GQA 8/4 (head_dim 128, same as the 1.5B teacher and the 0.5B mini), SwiGLU 2816, tied 64k embeddings, RoPE 5e5, seq 4096. Pruned one-shot out of morena0p5b-mini step_00010000 by prune_mini.py, then distilled from the 1.5B teacher morena1p5b-mid step_00075083 with CE + KL(teacher||student) by train_distill.py. GLOBAL BATCH = 256 seqs x 4096 = 1.05M tokens/step, node-count invariant: on 64 GPUs micro_batch 2 x grad_accum 2 x 64 = 256 exactly. 10,000 steps = 10.5B tokens. LR 3e-4, warmup 200, WSD 1-sqrt decay over the last 1,000 steps, identical to the mini so the two runs are comparable step for step.
